messages:
maria: Quick sync — I put together a short statuspage blurb + timing plan for the degraded inference incident. Need sign-off and notes for translations + inbound routing. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1860004
lauren: dropping in — can you paste the proposed copy here so PMs and support can review?
aj: Thanks — also confirm when we flip the fallback so we can match the message to the technical state.
maria: pasted below. TL;DR: 1) publish initial 'investigating' update immediately, 2) follow with 'mitigating' once fallback is live, 3) final 'resolved' with root cause + impact window.

maria: ```
Status: Investigating — We’re seeing elevated token latencies and partial failures for text-generation requests in hosted eu-west-1. Our engineers are actively investigating and have put automated fallbacks in place for high-priority accounts. We’ll post another update within 30 minutes with progress or a mitigation.
```
lauren: Tone looks good. Suggest we add one sentence about customer impact segmentation — e.g., 'most customers will see increased latency; a small subset may experience request failures.'
eli: +1 to segmentation sentence. Also ask legal to bless mention of 'high-priority accounts' if that's a paid-tiers callout.
maria: noted. I added: "most customers will see increased latency; a subset of requests may fail for high-concurrency workloads." Does that avoid naming tiers?
lauren: yes. good.

sam: Ops note — fallback to smaller model variant goes live at T+18m once canary metrics hit target. We should publish 'mitigating' at that point. AJ will post confirmation.
aj: will post a short ops message here when done. Also, can we include a short snippet for the status page timeline so customers know next update ETA?
maria: added ETA line: 'Next update ~30 minutes. We’ll update sooner if status changes.'

maria: Draft publish schedule: 
- Now: publish "Investigating" (maria)
- +18m: publish "Mitigating" when fallback confirmed (aj)
- +2h: if degraded still ongoing, publish expanded impact + workaround details and escalate comms to enterprise reps (maria/lauren)
- Resolution: publish RC, duration, and links to postmortem (maria)

eli: Routing ask — support should tag enterprise customers in Intercom and send a templated note. Can marketing prepare short email + Slack snippet for AE handoff?
maria: yes, I'll prepare two variants: 1) short in-product status + link, 2) email for enterprise AEs w/ suggested subject lines and customer-specific note spots.

lauren: Translations — we need FR, DE, JP for status page and email templates. Marketing ops: please prepare translations using vendor X (turnaround 45m). If not ready by Mitigating stage, publish in EN and add translated note.
maria: @ops-bot can you trigger the translation request ticket?
ops-bot: Translation request created: TICKET-4931. Vendor: LangFlow. ETA: 45 minutes. Assigned to: marketing-ops.

eli: Comms cadence for social/webinar folks — we should hold scheduled benchmark post and webinar reminder until incident resolves or we have explicit all-clear. Recommend postponing any external promotional messages for 24 hours.
maria: Agreed — pausing outbound promos. Will circulate a short hold notice to comms channel.

aj: Mitigating now — fallback model in canary, latency down ~40%. Posting 'Mitigating' update now.
maria: publishing statuspage: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1860004 — copy updated with mitigation note. Pinging enterprise list.

aj: Confirmed fallback healthy.
lauren: Marketing: please push AE email now (templated) and add note to knowledge base with workaround snippet: `set model_fallback=true` for SDK clients until full recovery.
maria: sending AE template and KB snippet now. Template subject options: "Service update: temporary inference degradation" or "Update: inference latency and temporary workaround" — prefer second?

eli: prefer second, more actionable.
maria: Email sent to AEs + Intercom segment queued. Translations ticket still in progress (TICKET-4931).

sam: Ops will open postmortem once fully resolved; expect draft in 24h. Add marketing to reviewers for customer-facing RC.

maria: Final note on tone: be transparent, concise, and avoid speculation. Include mitigation steps we took and clear next steps for customers. Reactions welcome. :thumbsup: :eyes:
